theorems.name: Submission.tgc_tilted_cone_inclusion
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (P T : Grassmannian N n) (v w : Euclidean N), 0 < L → L ≤ 1 → (∀ u : Euclidean N, ‖Grassmannian.project T u - Grassmannian.project P u‖ ≤ L / 4 * ‖u‖) → L * ‖Grassmannian.project P v‖ < ‖v - Grassmannian.project P v‖ → ‖w - v‖ ≤ L / 8 * ‖v‖ → L / 16 * ‖w‖ ≤ ‖w - Grassmannian.project T w‖ ∧ ‖w‖ ≤ 2 * ‖v‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
